title: The Bomb
description: At the end of [blue]3[/blue] turns, deal [blue]40[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
smart_description: At the end of [blue]3[/blue] turns, deal [blue]40[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
notes: Counter-type power that decrements by 1 each turn. When the counter reaches 1 at the end of a turn, it detonates, dealing 40 damage to all hittable enemies, then removes itself. The smart description updates based on remaining turns (e.g., 'this turn' when only 1 turn remains). The visual countdown makes the duration clear during combat.
